metadata.title: Forseti probes 2026: five preregistered experiments on Norwegian public-service fact checking
metadata.description:
Five preregistered experiments on whether a language model's handling of Norwegian public-service facts can be checked mechanically. Each carries a preregistration committed before the run it governs; four further pieces of work are engineering tasks with no hypothesis to preregister.

Four of five preregistered criteria were not met, and the reports say so in their own words: «trenger data» (fase 1), «overfører ikke» (fase 1b), «virker ikke» (fase 3, 3b and 3c).

The useful result came from a control. The question «who is claiming this number?» looked like a classification problem and was not one. A linear probe learning it from the sentence reached 0,852 against a 0,867 regex baseline and caught 1 of 13 known false accusations. Feeding the probe the user's prompt made it worse (0,6914): mean-pooling over a shared prefix cut the share of variance within an answer from 45,0 % to 30,4 %. Looking the figure up instead — is it in any user turn? — together with a phone-number filter caught 13 of 13, with no model at all.

The caveat belongs with the result: none of the pairwise precision differences in that phase are distinguishable from noise (McNemar p = 0,22–1,00). The claim is not that regex is better, but that the probe bought no measurable gain while costing a 248 MB artifact and a torch dependency. Precision was never the right instrument — thirteen pairs out of 324 is 4 % of the data and drowns in an aggregate score.

New in v1.1.0. Fase 2b: a consequence map from amendments published in Norsk Lovtidend (Lovdata's open NLOD 2.0 dataset) to the register rows that rest on the amended law. 4499 announcements from 2024–2026 were read and 157 touch the register. A backwards test finds all 5 known amendments, but four of them at document level only: just 5,9 % of the announcements carry paragraph-level change markup (265 of 4499). And the metningsvakt: four guards over register and tail saturation, each tested on a case it must fire on and a case it must stay silent on. Neither is preregistered, and the deposit says so.

The title is corrected in v1.1.0. v1.0.0 was titled «six preregistered experiments»; there are five, and the table in its own README said so. The concept DOI is unchanged, and the v1.0.0 record keeps the title it was published with.

Also deposited: a Norwegian public-sector fact register (118 rows in v1.0.0, 121 in v1.1.0) converted to YAML on the OpenFisca pattern, with every incomplete field flagged rather than guessed, a checker that catches a stale grunnbeløp value in a historical commit, and a change detector that finds the 2026 grunnbeløp change from two real page snapshots.

The scenario pack used as the test set in fase 1 and 1b is not included (the README names it). It is SimulaMet's, its content is sensitive, and it was used as a test set only. No prompt text, and nothing from which a prompt could be reconstructed, is in this deposit: 0 hits at 5-, 6-, 7- and 8-word windows, and 0,0 % of any single prompt recoverable, rechecked on the v1.1.0 tarball. The verification script is included so the check can be rerun by anyone who holds the pack.

Code is Apache-2.0; preregistrations, reports, data and figures are CC BY 4.0.
